What we're serving

Three reasons to stop by

Every Stiffler visit covers the full fair-food arc — savoury and fried, warm and sweet, cold and creamy.

The main event

Fried Foods

Golden, crispy, and made for walking the midway. The savoury heart of the fair — hot from the fryer at both Fair Park booths.

Find a booth →
Baked fresh

Stiffler's Mom's Cookie Factory

Fresh chocolate chip cookies, warm and loaded with chips. The smell alone will find you before you find the booth.

Find a booth →
Homemade

Stiffler's Poppin Johnny

Homemade ice cream to cool down a Texas fair day. The perfect finish after the fried stuff — or a very good place to start.

🍂 Prime season: Sept – Oct

Stiffler is a seasonal business, and the big moment is the State Fair of Texas in September and October. That's when Fair Park is at full buzz — and both booths are at their busiest and best.

Ask about the season
Good to know

Quick questions

Where exactly are you?

At Fair Park in Dallas — 1200 Admiral Nimitz Cir, Dallas, TX, on the State Fair of Texas grounds. We run two booths on site.

What are your hours?

We're open daily from 11 AM to 10 PM.

What do you serve?

Fried foods, fresh chocolate chip cookies from Stiffler's Mom's Cookie Factory, and homemade ice cream from Stiffler's Poppin Johnny.

When is the best time to visit?

We're a seasonal business — prime season is September to October during the State Fair of Texas, when Fair Park is in full swing.

How do I get in touch?

Email us any time at stifflerconcessionsllc@gmail.com, or use the form below.
